about: Eval questions for lookup-agent. Expected answers for database questions are not written here: the scorer runs each case's truth SQL against the seeded database, so they can't drift from the data. Currency answers are checked against a live rate fetched during the run. See eval/scoring.py for how each check works.

cases.question: what's your return window?
Do I have to pay for return shipping if you sent me the wrong item, or is it only free when the product is defective?
How long does standard shipping usually take, and do you offer express delivery for an extra fee?
Does the warranty cover products I bought as a gift for someone else, and what do I need to show to make a claim?
Is there a free trial for the premium plan, and what happens to my premium benefits if a monthly payment fails?
how long do refunds take to show up on my card?
Can I change the delivery address after placing an order, and if the package is already out for delivery, what are my options?
How many orders were cancelled between January 1 and January 31, 2026?

truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'

cases.question: List the names and cities of premium customers who signed up between January 1 and February 15, 2026 and placed at least one non-cancelled order over $150 before June 30, 2026.

truth.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.plan = 'premium' AND c.signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-02-15' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.total > 150 AND o.order_date < '2026-06-30'

cases.question: Which 3 products had the highest total quantity sold in orders placed between April 1 and June 30, 2026, not counting cancelled orders?

truth.sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: What's the average order total for basic-plan customers in Kathmandu for non-cancelled orders placed between January 1 and June 30, 2026?

truth.sql: SELECT round(avg(o.total), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.plan = 'basic' AND c.city = 'Kathmandu' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

cases.question: how many customers have more than one open delivery ticket created between February 1 and May 31, 2026?

truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'delivery' AND status = 'open' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 1) t

cases.question: Which customers bought something from the electronics category in a non-cancelled order dated between May 1 and May 31, 2026 and later opened a "quality" ticket on or before June 30, 2026?

truth.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN support_tickets t ON t.customer_id = c.id WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' AND t.topic = 'quality' AND t.created_at > o.order_date AND t.created_at <= '2026-06-30'

cases.question: What's the exchange rate from GBP to USD today?
Convert 250 euros to Indian rupees at the current rate.
what's the current rate for Australian dollars against US dollars, and how much is 500 AUD in USD?

Which premium customers had a delivered order between January 10 and March 31, 2026 and then opened a refund ticket between April 1 and April 30, 2026, and what does the refund policy say about premium members?

truth.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN support_tickets t ON t.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.plan = 'premium' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-03-31' AND t.topic = 'refund' AND t.created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

cases.question: What was the total of the order Priya Sharma placed on February 18, 2026, in Canadian dollars at today's rate?

truth.sql: SELECT o.total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.full_name = 'Priya Sharma' AND o.order_date = '2026-02-18'

cases.question: How many orders placed between March 1 and March 31, 2026 are still marked "processing", and according to the shipping policy, how long should they have taken to ship?

truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'processing' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'

cases.question: Omar Haddad has a damaged-item ticket dated May 9, 2026. What did he order on May 2, 2026, what's that order's total in GBP at today's rate, and does the damaged-item policy cover it?

truth.sql: SELECT p.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE c.full_name = 'Omar Haddad' AND o.order_date = '2026-05-02'
SELECT o.total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.full_name = 'Omar Haddad' AND o.order_date = '2026-05-02'

cases.question: Which basic-plan customers have a combined total of more than $1,000 across their non-cancelled orders placed between January 1 and June 30, 2026, and would the premium plan's free shipping rule have applied to orders of that size?

truth.sql: SELECT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.plan = 'basic' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.full_name HAVING sum(o.total) > 1000

cases.question: What was the total value of delivered orders placed in March 2026?

cases.question: Which city has the most customers?
